semantic.justification: Task YYAGKX ports the Unicode ScStringUtil::parseSimpleNumber scanner with original space/NBSP trimming and group normalization, decimal/alternative separators, first-group permissiveness, three-digit subsequent groups, exponent/sign ordering and scientific default true. Real RTL Unicode conversion preserves binary64 status, full parse-end checks and output-reference assignment on converter failure; early prechecks preserve the output. JS code-unit arrays replace only the temporary native Unicode buffer. The original testCSV numeric cases are executed plus source-derived boundaries. Task AQF9AG adds ScSetStringParam's source defaults, TextFormatPolicy values, text/numeric switches and unchanged formatter/listening/link members, and ScStringUtil::isMultiline's CR/LF scan for the CSV literal branch. Full formatter/date input classification, byte overload, other ScStringUtil operations and full module parity remain unported.
